title: Case 049: Written Neighbour Claim
initial_request: I’ve received a letter from my neighbour about ceiling damage possibly linked to 149 Maple Walk, Brackenford, ZZ6 4ZZ. I’ve only been able to summarise it so far; please tell me how to provide the full letter and have it passed to my insurer.
overview: Amy Wilson told Dan at Wyvern Cover that her neighbour had made a written claim about possible water damage, but Dan did not yet have the full letter or its date of receipt. Dan asked Amy to provide both through a protected channel and not to admit liability. Amy supplied Alex Rowe's complete letter dated 24 August 2025 (received 25 August), and Dan submitted it to Northmere Mutual, and the insurer confirmed receipt. The claim remains unresolved.

next_action.summary: At escalation, ask Amy to upload the full letter and its date of receipt through the protected document channel, then refer the complete claim to Northmere Mutual without admitting liability.

outcome: Northmere Mutual confirmed receipt of the neighbour’s claim; no decision on liability or cover has been made.

events.body: I’ve received a letter dated 24 August from my neighbour Alex Rowe about water damage they think might be connected to 149 Maple Walk, Brackenford, ZZ6 4ZZ. I can explain the gist, but I don’t have the full wording to hand.

Please send the complete letter and tell me the date you received it using our protected document channel, so I can pass the actual wording to Northmere Mutual. Please don’t admit responsibility or respond to the neighbour about the claim while we arrange this.

I received Alex Rowe's letter on 25 August 2025 and have uploaded the complete neighbour-letter.png through the protected document channel. Alex reports a damp hallway ceiling noticed on 23 August and requests that I refer the allegation to my insurer; I have not agreed that my property caused it.

I am submitting Alex Rowe's written claim concerning alleged water damage possibly associated with 149 Maple Walk, Brackenford, ZZ6 4ZZ, under reference CLM-049. The complete letter, neighbour-letter.png, dated 24 August and received on 25 August, have been passed through the protected claim channel for your review; this submission is not an admission of liability.
We confirm receipt of the neighbour’s claim and the accompanying letter under reference CLM-049. This acknowledgement confirms receipt only and does not determine liability or cover.

Northmere Mutual has confirmed receipt of your neighbour’s claim and the letter you supplied. The dispute is not resolved, and you should not respond to the neighbour on the substance of the claim unless authorised.
